title: JIBALI — من قلب الجبل، لقلب البيت. (Pruna cinematic version)
style: Ultra-photoreal cinematic film still, Lebanese mountain heritage, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, 35mm anamorphic look, restrained colour grade with limestone, wheat-gold and deep green tones. No text, no logos, no watermarks.
hoopoe: Eurasian hoopoe (Upupa epops): orange-buff body, bold black-and-white barred wings and tail, long slender down-curved bill, fan-shaped crest with black tips

stills.purpose: Character reference so the same bird appears in shots 01 and 02

input.prompt: Photoreal wildlife photograph of a single Eurasian hoopoe (Upupa epops) perched on a pale limestone rock, side profile, crest fully fanned with black tips, orange-buff body, bold black-and-white barred wings, long slender down-curved bill, soft golden morning light, plain blurred mountain background, sharp feather detail

Keep the exact landscape of image 1: Mount Hermon (Jabal al-Sheikh, Haramoun) is a LONG, BROAD, gently rounded massif whose snow-covered ridge stretches almost flat across the whole horizon, with several soft summits; it is NOT a cone-shaped volcano and has no single pointed peak. In the lower third, the village of Rashaya with stone houses and red tiled roofs on the green hillside, as in image 1. Photoreal cinematic sunrise, warm low sun from the right, light haze in the valley. The hoopoe from image 2 flies across the middle of the frame from left to right, seen from the side in a three-quarter view, wings spread mid-beat showing the black-and-white bars, crest folded back, long curved bill pointing right. 35mm film look. No text.

Photoreal cinematic shot: the hoopoe from image 1 landing on a small pale limestone rock in a field of ripe golden whole-wheat on a Lebanese mountain slope, the snow-capped ridge of Jabal al-Sheikh (Mount Hermon) softly out of focus in the distance like image 2, golden-hour backlight through the wheat ears, shallow depth of field. No text.

Photoreal cinematic three-quarter view from slightly above of a traditional Lebanese stone grain mill: two SOLID round millstones lie flat, one stacked on the other, each a thick unbroken stone disc with no slots or cuts. A wooden hopper above drops whole-wheat kernels into the small round hole at the centre of the upper stone. Fine light-brown whole-wheat flour with bran specks pours out from the thin gap all around the rim between the two stones and piles up on the circular stone platform around them, then slides into a wooden trough. Warm side light through a small window, flour dust glowing in the air, old limestone walls, 35mm film look. No text.

Photoreal cinematic close-up of a Lebanese grandmother's hands kneading LIGHT-BROWN WHOLE-WHEAT dough with visible bran flecks (not white dough) in a wide wooden bowl on a rustic table; a little water glistening, a few coarse salt crystals, whole-wheat flour on the fingers and wrists, soft warm window light, natural skin texture, correct anatomy with five fingers on each hand, 35mm film look. No text.

Photoreal cinematic shot of traditional Lebanese saj baking: a large dark steel saj, a CONVEX DOME shaped like an upside-down wok curving upward, set on stones over a small controlled wood fire. A very large, round, paper-thin whole-wheat bread, almost translucent, thin and porous exactly like the bread in image 1, is draped over the top of the dome and follows its curve, its edges hanging down the sides, with small golden-brown bubbles and spots. It is NOT a flat pan and NOT a thick flatbread. A stack of finished thin folded saj beside it, warm rustic mountain terrace at dusk, ember glow, 35mm film look. No text.

clips.prompt: The hoopoe flies smoothly across the frame from left to right high above the valley, with the snow-capped summit of Jabal al-Sheikh behind it; natural undulating flight with real wingbeats, gentle slow aerial camera drift, sunrise light through the haze. Realistic physics, the bird keeps the same appearance.

The hoopoe, having just landed on the limestone rock, settles its feet, neatly folds its barred wings and slowly raises and fans its black-tipped crest, then turns its head; ripe wheat sways softly in the warm breeze. Slow cinematic push-in. Realistic physics, the bird keeps exactly the same appearance.

The upper millstone turns slowly and steadily on the lower stone, a thin stream of whole-wheat kernels trickles down into it, fine flour dust drifts and glows in the warm window light. Static camera with a very slight push-in. Realistic physics.

The grandmother's hands press, fold and push the whole-wheat dough with the heels of the palms in a calm steady rhythm, a little flour puffs up. Natural hand movement, stable fingers, the bowl stays still. No extra ingredients.

The paper-thin bread on the dome bakes: small bubbles rise and turn golden-brown, steam curls up, the small wood fire flickers below with drifting embers. Slow cinematic push-in. The bread stays paper-thin and draped on the dome.
